task: Reconstruct eight rolling 15-minute candles from the last 120 visible minutes; last four candles describe the last 60 minutes.
scale_fit: Median absolute TRAIN close displacement; log-lag regression exponent, clipped to [0.1,0.9].
input: Only angular log-price displacement vectors and observation fractions; learned relative-position/scale embeddings in model. No prices, anchors, volatility levels, future candles, or target values in forward input.
target: Same angular per-channel displacements between consecutive reconstructed 15-minute OHLC candles.
aggregate: Sum raw log-channel displacements before angle encoding; reconstruct path, max High/first Open/last Close/min Low.
availability: Last 415 M1 minutes must be real consecutive candles; longer calendar histories forward-filled with observation fraction.
exposure: Research-exposed raw data; stage one deterministic past reconstruction, not forecasting validation.
